idea-plugin.name: MailKit
idea-plugin.description:
A comprehensive toolkit for working with email messages (EML / RFC 822 / MSG) directly in your IDE. MailKit offers syntax highlighting, code folding, smart inspections, and a fully featured embedded SMTP client for testing.

Editor & Formatting

  • Syntax Highlighting: Colorize headers, MIME boundaries, and body content. Customize colors per-header in the color scheme settings.
  • Code Folding: Collapse and expand nested MIME parts. RFC 2047 encoded header values (e.g. =?UTF-8?...?=) are automatically folded into human-readable text.
  • Customization: Add custom headers to the highlight list and toggle highlighting globally via Settings.

Attachments & Conversion

  • Attachment Management: Save attachments to disk or open them directly with the system app. Supports decoding for base64, quoted-printable, 7bit, 8bit, and binary parts. Includes confirmation prompts before opening executables.
  • Outlook MSG Conversion: Convert .msg files to standards-compliant .eml right from the Project view, complete with full internet transport header extraction. If original headers are missing, MailKit synthesizes them from MAPI properties and documents them in an X-MailKit-Synthesized-Headers field for full transparency. It also features multipart/alternative body selection and recursive embedded-message support. S/MIME messages keep their signed/encrypted envelope verifiable, calendar items export an invite.ics (with recurrence support), contacts a vCard and tasks a VTODO, OLE-embedded objects survive as .ole attachments, and threading, importance, sensitivity, reply-to, categories and delegate-send (From/Sender) metadata is preserved.
  • Outlook PST/OST Conversion: Convert entire .pst or .ost archives into a directory tree of standard EML files, with duplicate handling, optional message limits, and seamless support for Highly Encrypted and Password Protected files. Automatically falls back to internal legacyExchangeDN routing addresses when standard SMTP information is missing. As with MSG conversion, messages lacking original internet headers have them synthesized from MAPI properties and recorded in an X-MailKit-Synthesized-Headers field. Optionally recovers soft-deleted and orphaned messages that are no longer linked into the folder tree. Calendar appointments and meeting requests are exported with an attached invite.ics — recurring series keep their recurrence rule, time zone and deleted occurrences, and meeting responses record the attendee's accept/decline/tentative status. Delivery-status notifications and read receipts are reconstructed as a proper multipart/report, and S/MIME messages keep their signed/encrypted envelope verifiable (multipart/signed / application/pkcs7-mime) — parity with the MSG conversion. Contacts (vCard), tasks (VTODO), sticky notes, journal entries and distribution lists can be converted too via an opt-in checkbox; most other Outlook item types (documents, recall/remote/resend utility items, item-status reports) now convert as plain messages instead of being skipped, and an optional checksum-verification mode surfaces archive corruption that would otherwise pass silently. Sensitivity, conversation threading (Thread-Topic/Thread-Index), Reply-To and attachment Content-Location metadata survives the conversion.

Inspections & Validation

  • EML Inspections: Flag RFC 5322 / MIME violations inline. Includes checks for missing required headers, unterminated boundaries, base64 alphabet errors, charset mismatches, unparseable dates, and more.
  • Quick-Fixes: Easily resolve structural violations with Alt+Enter.

SMTP & Delivery Testing

  • Send EML: A powerful, swaks-equivalent embedded client. Send EMLs through configured profiles using STARTTLS, TLS-on-connect, and SASL (including SCRAM-SHA-256).
  • Quick Access: A "Send EML..." button directly in the editor toolbar, which can be toggled off in settings.
  • Batch Sending: Select several EML files and send them in one go — a shared envelope, per-file progress right in the dialog, and a choice to continue or stop when a message fails.
  • Advanced SMTP Features: ESMTP extensions, XCLIENT, HAProxy PROXY v1/v2, and per-send envelope overrides.
  • Save Overrides to Profile: Tweak the host, port, or envelope right in the Send dialog and optionally write the new values back to the selected profile — perfect for switching environments.
  • Envelope and Bcc Safety: The Send dialog accepts display-name addresses and comma-separated recipient lists, and strips a Bcc: header from the transmitted message — warning you first — so blind recipients are never disclosed to the other recipients.
  • Profile Management: PasswordSafe-backed profiles manage everything from Security/TLS to Relay framing. Live tool-window transcript keeps you informed.
